title: Deduplicate PinService coverage and mock boilerplate across pin_service_extended_test.dart and pin_service_profile_test.dart

evidence.quote: class MockFlutterSecureStorage extends Mock implements FlutterSecureStorage {}
class MockFlutterSecureStorage extends Mock implements FlutterSecureStorage {}

why: pin_service_extended_test.dart and pin_service_profile_test.dart independently re-test setProfilePin/verifyProfilePin/hasProfilePin/clearProfilePin, profile-scoped lockout (5-failure trigger, reset-on-success, getProfileLockoutRemainingMinutes), and the equivalent tutor-PIN surface — same scenarios, different profileId constants and wording, roughly 90% overlap. All three pin_service test files also copy-paste an identical ~35-line MockFlutterSecureStorage/createMockStorage fake instead of sharing one. If PinService's lockout-duration formula regresses, which copy a reviewer happens to update determines whether CI catches it; every change to the fake's stubbing has to be repeated three times or it silently drifts.
recommendation: Merge pin_service_extended_test.dart and pin_service_profile_test.dart into one file, keeping the union of scenarios. Extract MockFlutterSecureStorage/createMockStorage into a shared test/helpers/fake_secure_storage.dart used by all PinService tests.
acceptance_criteria: Only one PinService profile/tutor-PIN extended-coverage file remains, with zero scenario loss versus the union of both originals.

corrections: TQ-1 is mistagged — that rule is about pyramid shape (unit>widget>integration), not scenario duplication. This is a Fowler duplication-lens finding, which the digest explicitly permits as in-scope beyond named rule IDs; substance unaffected.
